xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
The tax authorities invoked the provisions of section 263 of Income-tax Act, 1961 and have sought to disallow certain deduction in AY 2011-12. The Company has appealed against the disallowance and a detailed written submissions have already been filed before the Ld. CIT(Appeals) and the matter is pending for adjudication.
Separately, the Company is in appeal before the Hon’ble Telangana High Court against disallowance under section 14A of the Income-tax Act, 1961 in the original assessment order for AY 2011-12. The matter is pending for adjudication by the Hon’ble High Court.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is still pending for adjudication at various levels, no update during the quarter.
